title: DLaR: Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33962v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent reasoning enables LLMs to operate in continuous embedding space, yet existing methods suffer from deterministic inference that precludes exploration of diverse reasoning paths. While recent approaches inject stochasticity to restore exploration, we identify two fundamental limitations: \textit{uniform stochasticity} across all steps is suboptimal, and unconstrained perturbations disrupt reasoning coherence. We propose Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning (DLaR), a framework with two complementary mechanisms that operate at different temporal granularities within the GRPO reinforcement learning framework. At the token level, Adaptive Stochasticity Modulation (ASM) dynamically adjusts perturbation intensity at each latent step based on a confidence-entropy fusion signal, increasing exploration when the model is uncertain and preserving stability when confident. translated_title: DLaR：面向大语言模型潜在推理的动态随机性控制
translated_abstract: 潜在推理使大语言模型（LLM）能够在连续嵌入空间中进行推理，然而现有方法受制于确定性推理，无法探索多样化的推理路径。尽管近期方法通过注入随机性来恢复探索能力，我们指出了两个根本性局限：在所有步骤上施加*均匀随机性*是次优的，且无约束的扰动会破坏推理的连贯性。我们提出了面向潜在推理的动态随机性控制（DLaR），这是一个包含两种互补机制的框架，这两种机制在GRPO强化学习框架内以不同的时间粒度运作。在token层面，自适应随机性调制（ASM）基于置信度-熵融合信号动态调整每个潜在步骤的扰动强度，在模型不确定时增强探索，在模型自信时保持稳定性。在训练层面，训练感知的随机性调优……
tldr: 该论文提出DLaR框架，通过在token层面基于置信度-熵融合信号自适应调节扰动强度、在训练层面感知训练进程调优随机性，解决了潜在推理中均匀随机性次优和无约束扰动破坏连贯性的问题，实现探索与稳定性的动态平衡。
